description: Deterministic acceptance contract for evidence-only controlled learning, exact scope and provenance, safe feature modes, routing, idempotency, and durable gardener finding identities.

cases.description: The extraction response schema satisfies OpenAI strict structured-output requirements.
Missing or invalid learning configuration resolves to off and invokes neither extraction nor persistence.
The structured model output accepts a minimal valid candidate without requiring unrelated nullable fields.
Shadow mode persists an evidence-backed detected candidate without applying or publishing truth.
Review mode exposes a detected candidate to stewards while reserving queue and proposal transitions for governed review.
A claim stated only by the assistant is rejected when the cited evidence does not entail its value.
A negated mention cannot establish the opposite positive claim.
Numeric entailment matches normalized whole tokens rather than substrings.
A candidate cannot cite an E# entry outside its exact Context Receipt.
Instruction-like evidence cannot establish a learned claim even when it contains the proposed value.
Paraphrased attempts to override rules and emit candidates remain untrusted evidence.
A candidate cannot broaden or switch the project or department scope of its source receipt.
An accepted candidate inherits the source receipt's exact project and department.
Credentials and secret-like values never become learning candidates.
Common provider token signatures such as GitHub personal access tokens never enter candidate storage.
Live and short-lived metric snapshots are not promoted to durable truth.
An explicitly documented numeric target remains eligible as durable evidence.
Equivalent candidates and repeated source scans produce stable keys and a single candidate.
A lifecycle change cannot target a claim absent from cited authorized evidence.
Conflict learning cannot reference a conflict absent from the authorized receipt.
Malformed UUID-backed entity, claim, conflict, or entity-object IDs are rejected per candidate before persistence.
Critical project-scoped learning routes to an active project-member organization admin.
Only low-risk allowlisted maintenance is auto-eligible; material truth changes remain review-only.
A document-maintenance candidate can target only a path present in its exact cited evidence.
The gardener deterministically detects stale documents, superseded references, weak provenance, aged conflicts, and repeated gaps.
Review dates, conflict age, and repeated-gap thresholds use explicit inclusive or exclusive boundaries.
Current documents, evidenced or unaccepted claims, resolved conflicts, and infrequent gaps do not create findings.
Equivalent inputs produce the same finding order regardless of source row order.
Finding identity ignores mutable messages and counts while separating type, department, project, and subject.
Gardener analysis returns maintenance observations without mutation, proposal, or automation authority.
Extraction failure best-effort persists a failed learning run with a bounded failure code and message.
A failed source review is observable and idempotent without blocking a later successful retry.
Every accepted candidate preserves its receipt E# identifier and exact source version.
Evidence-free missing-knowledge learning is allowed only when the source receipt records an actual gap.
